title: StereoDroidVR: a phone in a Cardboard-style viewer as a VR headset for SteamVR on Linux
description: StereoDroidVR is the Android phone headset project for PC VR with head tracking. KDE Connect pairing is required; picture, head pose and camera redirection share one RDP session. PC applications reach OpenXR, with OpenVR through xrizer. The complete tracked headset remains unqualified; this repository contains documentation, not an Android build target.
